match.*: This quote is valid until {day}. Once accepted, it binds both parties on its terms. It is not an invoice: each payment is invoiced when it falls due.

notice_price: The total price includes IGIC and every other applicable tax.

match.*: The customer opens the quote's link, reads it, types their full name, draws their signature, and accepts it. That acceptance is their electronic signature. {issuer} keeps the accepted document and emails a copy within 24 hours. Before accepting, the customer can ask for a revised quote to correct anything. The contract is concluded in {language}.

The customer can withdraw from the contract within 14 calendar days of the day they accept the quote, without giving any reason and at no cost. To do so, they only need to say so clearly to {email}, for example with the form at the end of this document. Work does not start within that period unless the customer expressly asks for it when accepting. In that case, if they then withdraw, they pay for the part already done in proportion to the total price, and they lose the right once the work is fully done.
Complaints are handled at {email}, with an answer within one month. Official complaint forms are available to the customer.

{controller} uses your data for this quote, the contract, and tax duties. A legitimate interest in proof of the agreement supports acceptance evidence. This includes your name, simple electronic signature (eIDAS), UTC time, IP address, browser user agent, and PDF SHA-256. Vercel hosts the app. Cloudflare protects traffic and receives payment events. Neon/Databricks stores data, Resend sends email, and Stripe processes payments and prevents fraud. Photon/komoot receives address text the issuer types for search. Authorized MCP agents act on the issuer’s behalf. US transfers use the EU-US Data Privacy Framework for covered entities and processing, and Standard Contractual Clauses for other transfers. Resend sends from Ireland but stores data in the United States. Unaccepted quotes last one year. Accepted quotes and evidence last for the contract and five years from the date the obligation becomes enforceable. Accounting duties or claims can require longer retention. Request access, correction, erasure, restriction, portability, or objection at {email}. You can complain to the AEPD. Full notice: https://hadronomy.com/invoices/privacy?lang=en.

privacy_intro: This notice explains how we use your data when you receive a quote or invoice, access your account, or pay.
privacy_controller_detail: The controller is the sole trader identified here, based in Santa Cruz de Tenerife. You can contact the controller about your data.
privacy_incomplete: The controller’s contact details are incomplete. Ask the issuer to complete the settings before you send personal data.
privacy_contract: We prepare and send quotes, record your response, provide the service, issue invoices, and manage payments and related messages. Contract performance or steps you request before a contract provide the legal basis (GDPR Article 6(1)(b)). For business contacts and representatives, we use our legitimate interest in the professional relationship (GDPR Article 6(1)(f), LOPDGDD Article 19). We limit these data to the professional role and do not use them for advertising.
privacy_tax: We keep invoices, payment records, and records required by accounting and tax law, including IGIC duties. Compliance with legal duties provides the basis (GDPR Article 6(1)(c)).
privacy_access: We send a one-time code to your email so you can view and pay your invoices. The access you request as part of the contractual relationship provides the legal basis. We do not send advertising to this address.
privacy_security: We protect access, prevent abuse, and preserve evidence of the quote you accept. Our legitimate interest in service security and proof of the agreement provides the basis (GDPR Article 6(1)(f)). We limit the evidence, access, and retention, and do not reuse it for tracking or advertising. These limits reduce the impact compared with the risk of impersonation or a dispute about the agreement. You can object for reasons related to your situation.
privacy_rights_purpose: We handle your data rights requests and security incidents. Data protection duties provide the legal basis (GDPR Article 6(1)(c)).
privacy_data_title: The data we use and their source
privacy_data: We use your name, tax ID where required, email, address, business contact details, quotes, invoices, messages, amounts, and payment status. We receive these data from you, the business you represent, or the commercial relationship with the issuer. Stripe collects card details directly. The app does not store your full card number or security code.
privacy_evidence: When you accept a quote, we keep your typed name, signature image, associated email, quote version, and accepted PDF. We also keep its SHA-256 digest, UTC date and time, IP address, and browser user agent. This is a simple electronic signature under eIDAS. It is not a qualified signature. We do not use the signature for biometric identification. We also use sign-in codes, session data, and technical security logs.
privacy_recipients_intro: The issuer and agents the issuer authorizes through MCP access data to manage the business. The agents act on the issuer’s behalf and instructions. Technical providers receive the data their services need:
privacy_vercel: Vercel Inc.: app hosting and execution, with functions in Frankfurt.
privacy_cloudflare: Cloudflare, Inc.: proxy, CDN, traffic protection, and the Worker that receives payment events. Its network operates across countries.
privacy_neon: Neon, part of Databricks: the PostgreSQL database in Frankfurt. Support and subprocessors can process data outside the EEA.
privacy_resend: Resend (Plus Five Five, Inc.): sign-in codes and messages about quotes and invoices. It sends from Ireland and stores messages and logs in the United States. It acts as processor for email delivery and independent controller for certain usage and security data.
privacy_stripe: Stripe: card payments and fraud prevention. It acts as processor for certain operations and independent controller for its legal duties and fraud prevention. Financial institutions and card networks also take part.
privacy_photon: Photon/komoot GmbH: address search that the issuer uses while editing. The server sends the address text the issuer types to the search service. It does not send the signature or document.
privacy_authorities: Tax authorities also receive data. Courts and professionals with confidentiality duties receive data where required for legal duties or claims. We do not sell your data.
privacy_transfers: Functions and the database are in Frankfurt, but transfers and access from the United States and other countries occur. Vercel Inc., Cloudflare, Inc., Databricks, Inc., Plus Five Five, Inc. (Resend), and Stripe, LLC use the EU-US Data Privacy Framework for covered transfers. This requires an active certification that covers the recipient and processing. Transfers without that coverage use European Commission Standard Contractual Clauses and any necessary additional safeguards. Photon/komoot is based in Germany. You can request a copy of the safeguards from the controller.
privacy_retention_title: How long we keep the data
privacy_keep_invoices: Invoices and payment records: six years from the last accounting entry under Commercial Code Article 30. We also apply the four-year tax limitation period, interruptions, extensions, and longer IGIC periods for adjustments and deductions. The latest applicable end date controls deletion.
privacy_keep_quotes: Unaccepted quotes: one year after expiry or rejection. Accepted quotes, PDFs, and evidence: for the contract and five years from the date the relevant obligation becomes enforceable. Accounting duties or a claim can require a later deletion date.
privacy_keep_access: Sign-in codes expire after ten minutes and stop working after use. Authentication cleanup removes expired records. The account lasts while you have invoice access. We delete it when that access ends, except for data required for legal duties or claims.
privacy_keep_logs: Technical security logs: up to thirty days, except incident evidence that needs longer retention. Resend keeps messages and logs for thirty days and backups for seven days. Acceptance records follow the quote retention period.
privacy_keep_backups: Our backups rotate within thirty days. Neon Free restore history covers about six hours. Provider backups follow their deletion schedules. Data deleted from active use can remain in isolated backups until rotation. After a restore, we apply deletions again.
privacy_keep_rights: Rights requests and incidents: during handling, then restricted for applicable liability periods. When each purpose ends, we restrict data to outstanding duties or claims and delete them when the period ends.
privacy_rights: You can request access, correction, erasure, restriction, and portability where applicable. You can object to processing based on legitimate interests for reasons related to your situation. Send your request to the controller’s email or postal address. We request only the information needed to confirm your identity. We normally respond within one month. Tax duties or claims can prevent immediate erasure.
privacy_complaint: You can complain to the Spanish Data Protection Agency (AEPD), at aepd.es, if you consider that processing infringes your rights.
privacy_required_title: The data you need to provide
privacy_required: The identity and billing data required by law are necessary to issue an invoice. Email is necessary for a code and account access. Your name and signature are necessary to accept a quote through this form. Without them, we cannot complete that operation. You can contact the issuer to agree another way to contract or pay.
privacy_automated: This app does not profile you or make automated decisions with legal effects on you. Stripe and financial institutions perform their own fraud and authentication checks under their responsibility.
privacy_cookies: We use a cookie to maintain your session. Another cookie remembers the language of the document you request. On the payment page, Stripe uses cookies and storage to process payments and prevent fraud. These include __stripe_mid (one year), __stripe_sid (thirty minutes), and m (up to two years). We do not use advertising or audience measurement storage on these pages. This necessary use does not require a consent banner. If you block this storage, access or payment can fail.
privacy_signin_short: {controller} uses your email for invoice access and session security, based on the contract and a legitimate interest in security.
privacy_payment_short: {controller} uses your data to manage payment and meet tax duties. Stripe collects your card details and performs fraud checks.
